rationale: Builds on the current best script by reclaiming wallclock from work that does not affect the score. The baseline spends roughly one full validation pass on an unscored final float-state eval, then still runs the scored int8 roundtrip eval. This variant skips that last float-only validation when `VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0`, lowers the default post-train reserve to match the exact scored path, and removes the unused `.npz` save plus disk reread before the final int8 roundtrip evaluation. The final `final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact` path and its print format stay intact; the hypothesis is that extra training steps on the best architecture are worth more than the discarded unscored validation pass.
title: Scored-Only Final Budget Reallocation
